7.2.4.4 Configuration
[SWS_BSW_00205] Detection of (extended) production errors
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00385, SRS_BSW_00466, SRS_BSW_00458
⌈The detection of production code errors and extended production errors cannot be
switched off, unless the Module SWS describes configuration parameters or other con-
ditions, which define the activation of certain (extended) production errors.⌋
